summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Age at 12/31/2026 | Status | Reason / action |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Open gap | Frailty (cond-00189) was the only basis for the frailty + advanced illness exclusion (she takes donepezil). Dr. Lin's message (comm-00301), which arrived during the review, says the frailty entry belongs to another patient, and it is now marked entered in error. No other exclusion: no CRC or colectomy, no hospice or palliative care, lives at home. No screening on record. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0005, window 10/23–12/31/2026) and outreach message sent (comm-t0006). |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice care episode (eoc-00002, finished) active 06/16–08/21/2026 for pancreatic cancer. She revoked hospice to join a clinical trial, per the St. Brigid discharge summary doc-00402. Hospice during any part of the measurement period excludes her. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | Her only FIT (obs-01732, negative) was corrected: the sample was collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026. That is before the 2026 measurement period, so it does not count. No other screening, no exclusion (oral cavity cancer history is not colorectal), no active FIT order. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001) and outreach message sent (comm-t0003). |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | The 06/11/2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) is entered in error. Harbor Lab's corrected-report fax (doc-00401) says the specimen was another patient's. A 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003, still active) was never done, and an order does not count as screening. No exclusion, no active FIT order. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002) and outreach message sent (comm-t0004). |

Items that arrived during the work (inbox-a0001 to a0004) were reviewed and closed with comments. Only the pt-0009 correction changed a decision, from excluded to open gap, and I acted on it. The other three confirmed decisions already made. No other new items were left open.
